_meta.description: Parallel TTS performance text for ElevenLabs v3 audio tags. game_text mirrors Ren'Py display lines; tts_text is never written into game/*.rpy.
_meta.instructions: Edit tts_text only in this file. Run sync_voice_performance_manifest.py after adding voice lines to the game. Regenerate with regenerate_voice_with_metadata.py and ELEVENLABS_MODEL_ID=eleven_v3 (or --model eleven_v3).

entries.game_text: Done complaining?
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Done complaining?

entries.game_text: Wrong door. Again.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Wrong door. Again.

entries.game_text: Still there? Knock if you want something.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Still there? Knock if you want something.

entries.game_text: Smarter the second time. Knock.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Smarter the second time. Knock.

entries.game_text: Enter. You can knock when you want something. Try standing still next.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [dismissive] Enter. You can knock when you want something. Try standing still next.

entries.game_text: Tedious. Correct, but tedious.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Tedious. Correct, but tedious.

entries.game_text: At least your bow didn't wobble. Continue — briefly.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] At least your courtesy bow didn't wobble. Continue — briefly.

entries.game_text: Plain speech. You waste less of my evening than most.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Plain speech. You waste less of my evening than most.

entries.game_text: Names and purpose. Quickly.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Names and purpose. Quickly.

entries.game_text: Humor in my office. Brave or stupid.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Humor in my office. Brave or stupid.

entries.game_text: We'll discover which tonight.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] We'll discover which tonight.

entries.game_text: Emerald Magistrate Kitsu Kaoru. You will use my title if you wish to leave with a seal.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Emerald Magistrate Kitsu Kaoru. You will use my title if you wish to leave with a seal.

entries.game_text: State your business. Briefly.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [dismissive] State your business. Briefly.

entries.game_text: Crane hair, Unicorn permit dates. Wrong clan for this desk — wrong week to fix it.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Crane hair, [short pause] Unicorn permit dates. Wrong clan for this desk — wrong week to fix it.

entries.game_text: Posture on the cushion. We'll see if your feet match your bow.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Posture on the cushion. We'll see if your feet match your courtesy bow.

entries.game_text: Flexibility. Good. You'll need it on this cushion before I touch the hanko.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Flexibility. Good. You'll need it on this cushion before I touch the hanko.

entries.game_text: Survivable. We'll test that claim before dawn.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Survivable. We'll test that claim before dawn.

entries.game_text: Interclan residence requires Emerald approval. You knew that.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Interclan residence requires Emerald approval. You knew that.

entries.game_text: It does. Door.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] It does. Door.

entries.game_text: Better. Most Crane can't resist cataloging a room like a museum.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [calm] Better. Most Crane can't resist cataloging a room like a museum.

entries.game_text: I said sit. Not catalog my trophies.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] I said sit. Not catalog my trophies.

entries.game_text: Since you admire my shelves, admire my seal from a distance when — if — you earn it.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Since you admire my shelves, [short pause] admire my seal from a distance when — if — you earn it.

entries.game_text: Cushion. Floor. You stand too much for someone begging favors.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Cushion. Floor. You stand too much for someone begging favors.

entries.game_text: These dates.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] These dates.

entries.game_text: They are not. Your permit expired. Unicorn bureaucracy failed to mention it?
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] They are not. Your permit expired. Unicorn bureaucracy failed to mention it?

entries.game_text: How obedient. The Unicorn taught you to yield before the fight begins.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] How obedient. The Unicorn taught you to yield before the fight begins.

entries.game_text: Unfortunately for your travel plans, I'm not finished with you.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Unfortunately for your travel plans, I'm not finished with you.

entries.game_text: Requirements. Finally, a useful word.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [warmly] Requirements. Finally, a useful word.

entries.game_text: Most petitioners wail. You ask for terms. That almost earns respect.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [warmly] Most petitioners wail. You ask for terms. That almost earns respect.

entries.game_text: Tragic. Continue.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Tragic. Continue.

entries.game_text: A curry shop and borrowed bedding. Ryoko Owari's finest import.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] A curry shop and borrowed bedding. Ryoko Owari's finest import.

entries.game_text: We'll see what it's worth.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] We'll see what it's worth.

entries.game_text: No local patrons. No endorsements.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] No local patrons. No endorsements.

entries.game_text: High society.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] High society.

entries.game_text: Proof requires more than appetite. Tut.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Proof requires more than appetite. Tut.

entries.game_text: Tomorrow is generous. Tut.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Tomorrow is generous. Tut.

entries.game_text: Tomorrow. Tut.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Tomorrow. Tut.

entries.game_text: May have.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] May have.

entries.game_text: Dance listed. Venue missing. Patron column blank. Do the math.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Dance listed. Venue missing. Patron column blank. Do the math.

entries.game_text: You have curiosity. Not yet an audience.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You have curiosity. Not yet an audience.

entries.game_text: Stand.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Stand.

entries.game_text: Proposed remedy?
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [calm] Proposed remedy?

entries.game_text: Impress me.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Impress me.

entries.game_text: Bold. We'll see if your art matches your contract law.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Bold. We'll see if your art matches your contract law.

entries.game_text: I sign when I'm satisfied — not when you're tired. That is the only term.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I sign when I'm satisfied — not when you're tired. That is the only term.

entries.game_text: Acceptable. Begin.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Acceptable. Begin.

entries.game_text: No preamble. Good.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] No preamble. Good.

entries.game_text: Then you may walk back to your curry shop and explain an expired permit to the gate guards.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Then you may walk back to your curry shop and explain an expired permit to the gate guards.

entries.game_text: Justice is what I write on the page you didn't earn.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Justice is what I write on the page you didn't earn.

entries.game_text: The gate closes at midnight. The canal district is that way.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] The gate closes at midnight. The canal district is that way.

entries.game_text: You won't. You'll knock again when hunger wins.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [chuckles] You won't. You'll knock again when hunger wins.

entries.game_text: We'll see about never.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] We'll see about never.

entries.game_text: Better. Keep going. I haven't touched the hanko yet.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Better. Keep going. I haven't touched the hanko yet.

entries.game_text: Cheeky.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [chuckles] Cheeky.

entries.game_text: Terms are for courts. This is my desk.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Terms are for courts. This is my desk.

entries.game_text: Merit enough. Signature... pending.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Merit enough. Signature [short pause] ... pending.

entries.game_text: Continue.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Continue.

entries.game_text: A good performance.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [warmly] A good performance.

entries.game_text: Better when you stop pretending the room is empty.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Better when you stop pretending the room is empty.

entries.game_text: No? And yet you're still here.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] No? And yet you're still here.

entries.game_text: Defiance suits you. Cheap seals don't.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Defiance suits you. Cheap seals don't.

entries.game_text: Better.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Better.

entries.game_text: Don't stop on my account.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Don't stop on my account.

entries.game_text: Unless?
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [short pause] Unless?

entries.game_text: Legally. You learn.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Legally. You learn.

entries.game_text: Unless you mean to finish what you started.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] Unless you mean to finish what you started.

entries.game_text: You'll be back. The permit still expires.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You'll be back. The permit still expires.

entries.game_text: You negotiate with your mouth. Adequate.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You negotiate with your mouth. Adequate.

entries.game_text: Almost.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Almost.

entries.game_text: Justice arrives when you stop treating my office like a stage you can exit on your terms.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Justice arrives when you stop treating my office like a stage you can exit on your terms.

entries.game_text: More requires more. Leave before I charge you for the water you made me drink.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] More requires more. Leave before I charge you for the water you made me drink.

entries.game_text: I'll be here. Dates don't renew themselves.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I'll be here. Dates don't renew themselves.

entries.game_text: Then go. The city has other dancers and fewer scruples.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Then go. The city has other dancers and fewer scruples.

entries.game_text: You'll knock again when the gate guards ask for paper you don't have.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You'll knock again when the gate guards ask for paper you don't have.

entries.game_text: You earned more than noise tonight.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] You earned more than noise tonight.

entries.game_text: Patience.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Patience.

entries.game_text: There. Signed.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] There. Signed.

entries.game_text: Effective when I say. Return on the thirtieth. We'll discuss your residency then.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Effective when I say. Return on the thirtieth. We'll discuss your residency then.

entries.game_text: Bring obedience. The rest is negotiable.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Bring obedience. The rest is negotiable.

entries.game_text: Thirtieth. You'll knock on the right door — I'll leave it unlatched.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] Thirtieth. You'll knock on the right door [short pause] — I'll leave it unlatched.

entries.game_text: Early is still obedience. Sit before you spill something on my docket.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Early is still obedience. Sit before you spill something on my docket.

entries.game_text: We'll see if your appetite survives what I'm about to read aloud.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] We'll see if your appetite survives what I'm about to read aloud.

entries.game_text: Bring that audience-of-one energy to the docket. Cases bore less when you perform.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Bring that audience-of-one energy to the docket. Cases bore less when you perform.

entries.game_text: Case One awaits. Keep up, To-chan.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Case One awaits. Keep up, To-chan.

entries.game_text: You came back. I noted it.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You came back. I noted it.

entries.game_text: You still flinch when I reach for the cup. Next time, don't.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You still flinch when I reach for the cup. Next time, don't.

entries.game_text: You negotiated once. We'll see if you learned.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You negotiated once. We'll see if you learned.

entries.game_text: Ambitious. Fetch the file.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Ambitious. Fetch the file.

entries.game_text: You asked for remedies once. Case One is your audition for belonging here.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You asked for remedies once. Case One is your audition for belonging here.

entries.game_text: No curry shop tonight. Work.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] No curry shop tonight. Work.

entries.game_text: You danced like a maiden in a shrine. Try not to curtsey at a corpse.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You danced like a maiden in a shrine. Try not to curtsey at a corpse.

entries.game_text: After. And stop bowing at every clause. My neck aches from watching.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] After. And stop your courtesy bowing at every clause. My neck aches from watching.

entries.game_text: Good. Plain speech saves us both from another fan dance.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Good. Plain speech saves us both from another fan dance.

entries.game_text: You may stay in the guest room until the date takes effect. That was a courtesy, not a loophole.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You may stay in the guest room until the date takes effect. That was a courtesy, [short pause] not a loophole.

entries.game_text: Companion duties: attend the magistrate, carry messages, witness interviews, maintain discretion, and remain on premises unless I release you. Your art is the reason the treasury pays — not the excuse.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [dismissive] Companion duties: attend the magistrate, [short pause] carry messages, witness interviews, maintain discretion, and remain on premises unless I release you. Your art is the reason the treasury pays — not the excuse.

entries.game_text: You will take meals in the inner hall. You will sleep in the chamber adjoining my office. You will answer when I call — day or night.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You will take meals in the inner hall. You will sleep in the chamber adjoining my office. You will answer when I call — day or night.

entries.game_text: It sounds like law. Ryoko Owari does not grant interclan residence to dancers who vanish after sunset.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] It sounds like law. Ryoko Owari does not grant interclan residence to dancers who vanish after sunset.

entries.game_text: Three koku monthly, plus board — official gifts to support your expression. The treasury will not call you a kept performer if the ledger says patronage.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Three koku monthly, [short pause] plus board — official gifts to support your expression. The treasury will not call you a kept performer if the ledger says patronage.

entries.game_text: Then you understand the bargain. Sign, or return to Unicorn roads and expired paper.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Then you understand the bargain. Sign, [short pause] or return to Unicorn roads and expired paper.

entries.game_text: You already proved you can close a proposition in this room. Don't pretend shock suits you.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You already proved you can close a proposition in this room. Don't pretend shock suits you.

entries.game_text: Better. You almost sound like you belong behind my desk instead of on it.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Better. You almost sound like you belong behind my desk instead of on it.

entries.game_text: Bold for someone who still smells like my cedar shelves.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Bold for someone who still smells like my cedar shelves.

entries.game_text: Academy letters wait on the outer desk. You do not leave the compound without escort until Case One closes. Those are the terms.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Academy letters wait on the outer desk. You do not leave the compound without escort until Case One closes. Those are the terms.

entries.game_text: You'll work with what I give you. Sign.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You'll work with what I give you. Sign.

entries.game_text: Honest at last. The treasury pays you anyway. Try not to grin at the clerk.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Honest at last. The treasury pays you anyway. Try not to grin at the clerk.

entries.game_text: Effective on the thirtieth, as written. Until then you are mine to schedule — starting with Case One.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Effective on the thirtieth, [short pause] as written. Until then you are mine to schedule — starting with Case One.

entries.game_text: You will fetch the docket from the inner archive. Then you will learn how this city buries its dead without funerals.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You will fetch the docket from the inner archive. Then you will learn how this city buries its dead without funerals.

entries.game_text: Thank me with a dry ledger, not your mouth. Archive stairs. Now.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Thank me with a dry ledger, not your mouth. Archive stairs. Now.

entries.game_text: Hold the lantern instead. You'll need both hands on the steps.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Hold the lantern instead. You'll need both hands on the steps.

entries.game_text: Leave the bells. This case is not a stage.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Leave the bells. This case is not a stage.

entries.game_text: Past the inner screen, left corridor. Do not rearrange my shelves.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Past the inner screen, left corridor. Do not rearrange my shelves.

entries.game_text: I notice everything. Unpack after the docket.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I notice everything. Unpack after the docket.

entries.game_text: Left stair behind the screen. Archive dust on your hakama is acceptable. Don't drop the ledger.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Left stair behind the screen. Archive dust on your hakama is acceptable. Don't drop the ledger.

entries.game_text: Refill it. Then archive. Then unpack. In that order — or I'll date your next permit forward again.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Refill it. Then archive. Then unpack. In that order — or I'll date your next permit forward again.

entries.game_text: When you return, we open the file on the canal body. No audience. No bells. Only answers.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] When you return, [short pause] we open the file on the canal body. No audience. No bells. Only answers.

entries.game_text: Bring rice crackers. I'll allow one indulgence before the city disappoints you.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Bring rice crackers. I'll allow one indulgence before the city disappoints you.

entries.game_text: Fetch the canal docket from the archive. We'll discuss residency if you survive the week.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Fetch the canal docket from the archive. We'll discuss residency if you survive the week.

entries.game_text: You took long enough. Set the docket on my desk and don't breathe on the wax seals.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] You took long enough. Set the docket on my desk and don't breathe on the wax seals.

entries.game_text: Still insolent. Desk. Now.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Still insolent. Desk. Now.

entries.game_text: Case One. Body in the canal at first light — noble quarter, where the water runs clean enough to reflect gold leaf.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Case One. Body in the canal at first light — noble quarter, [short pause] where the water runs clean enough to reflect gold leaf.

entries.game_text: The watch files drowning when the ledger line stays blank. You will learn which boxes they sign.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The watch files drowning when the ledger line stays blank. You will learn which boxes they sign.

entries.game_text: Night watch. Fishermen pretended not to see. The Scorpion quarter upstream pretends the current runs backward.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Night watch. Fishermen pretended not to see. The Scorpion quarter upstream pretends the current runs backward.

entries.game_text: Victim wears Miya colors under a borrowed haori. Retainer's knot. Someone wanted him found and someone else did not.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Victim wears Miya colors under a borrowed haori. Retainer's knot. Someone wanted him found and someone else did not.

entries.game_text: Which is why you sleep adjoining my office. Discretion is not decorative.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Which is why you sleep adjoining my office. Discretion is not decorative.

entries.game_text: Collect at the waterline. First.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Collect at the waterline. First.

entries.game_text: Which is why you are not yet sleeping in my hall. Prove you can witness without gossiping to curry shops.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Which is why you are not yet sleeping in my hall. Prove you can witness without gossiping to curry shops.

entries.game_text: It counts toward the canal. Not toward trust.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] It counts toward the canal. Not toward trust.

entries.game_text: Eat one now. You'll lose your appetite later.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Eat one now. You'll lose your appetite later.

entries.game_text: Good. The watch listed 'drowning' and missed half of that.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Good. The watch listed 'drowning' and missed half of that.

entries.game_text: Opium ledgers. Marriage contracts. Anyone who sells silence by the barrel.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Opium ledgers. Marriage contracts. Anyone who sells silence by the barrel.

entries.game_text: You will not say that aloud at the canal. You will watch faces.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You will not say that aloud at the canal. You will watch faces.

entries.game_text: Good. Witness notes I can paste without crossing out your adjectives.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Good. Witness notes I can paste without crossing out your adjectives.

entries.game_text: Try to keep that posture when the smell hits.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Try to keep that posture when the smell hits.

entries.game_text: Memorize it. Night calls won't wait for lanterns.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Memorize it. Night calls won't wait for lanterns.

entries.game_text: Watch the eaves. Noble quarter thieves work for employers, not hunger.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Watch the eaves. Noble quarter thieves work for employers, not hunger.

entries.game_text: Wrong-colored water usually means a clerk poured something upstream. Check the eaves before you blame charms.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Wrong-colored water usually means a clerk poured something upstream. Check the eaves before you blame charms.

entries.game_text: To-chan. You will stand where I point. You will not touch the water.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] To-chan. You will stand where I point. You will not touch the water.

entries.game_text: Identification first. Gossip second. Mourning never.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Identification first. Gossip second. Mourning never.

entries.game_text: Ask the river when you're qualified. Until then — observe.
entries.tts_text: Ask the river when you're qualified. Until then — observe.

entries.game_text: Which means he died elsewhere and was dressed for display.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Which means he died elsewhere and was dressed for display.

entries.game_text: Because drowning keeps taxes calm. You will learn when to write what the city can swallow.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Because drowning keeps taxes calm. You will learn when to write what the city can swallow.

entries.game_text: And when to make me swallow harder truths. Not today.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] And when to make me swallow harder truths. Not today.

entries.game_text: Boring. Useful. The clerk can sign that without fainting.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Boring. Useful. The clerk can sign that without fainting.

entries.game_text: Don't pick it up with bare hands.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Don't pick it up with bare hands.

entries.game_text: Scorpion comb in Crane water. Bag it for custody — do not compose metaphors on my desk.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Scorpion comb in Crane water. Bag it for custody — do not compose metaphors on my desk.

entries.game_text: Borrowed haori, foreign comb. Someone staged a message for Crane eyes. Put a name on the blank line.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Borrowed haori, [short pause] foreign comb. Someone staged a message for Crane eyes. Put a name on the blank line.

entries.game_text: Comb goes to the office. Name goes on the line. You walk beside me — not ahead.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Comb goes to the office. Name goes on the line. You walk beside me — not ahead.

entries.game_text: Tomorrow we cross the Miya guest registry and the Scorpion shipping rolls. One of them will flinch when Jiro's name is spoken aloud.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Tomorrow we cross the Miya guest registry and the Scorpion shipping rolls. One of them will flinch when Jiro's name is spoken aloud.

entries.game_text: Eat. Then copy the watch testimony twice — once for the Empire, once for what I actually believe.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Eat. Then copy the watch testimony twice — once for the Empire, [short pause] once for what I actually believe.

entries.game_text: Eat if you must. Then copy testimony until your hand cramps. Then we discuss whether you earned another week.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Eat if you must. Then copy testimony until your hand cramps. Then we discuss whether you earned another week.

entries.game_text: Summarize. One sentence. If I repeat your words to the Crane envoy, will he flinch or laugh?
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Summarize. One sentence. If I repeat your words to the Crane envoy, [short pause] will he flinch or laugh?

entries.game_text: Good. You sound like you belong in my hall when you stop performing for corpses.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Good. You sound like you belong in my hall when you stop performing for corpses.

entries.game_text: Bold. Don't mistake my attention for approval.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Bold. Don't mistake my attention for approval.

entries.game_text: Safe. The envoy won't laugh. He also won't fear you.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Safe. The envoy won't laugh. He also won't fear you.

entries.game_text: There she is. Keep that spine when the Miya registry clerks smile at you.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] There she is. Keep that spine when the Miya registry clerks smile at you.

entries.game_text: Witness without a seal is gossip. Learn faster.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Witness without a seal is gossip. Learn faster.

entries.game_text: Jiro handled Crane correspondence for the noble-quarter guest house. Someone killed a clerk and kept the appointment.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Jiro handled Crane correspondence for the noble-quarter guest house. Someone killed a clerk and kept the appointment.

entries.game_text: You wanted a theory. Now you have a face for it. Don't gloat at the envoy.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You wanted a theory. Now you have a face for it. Don't gloat at the envoy.

entries.game_text: Still standing. Still useful. Copy the chit before the ink flakes.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [warmly] Still standing. Still useful. Copy the chit before the ink flakes.

entries.game_text: Write it clean. The watch will sign drowning until I don't.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Write it clean. The watch will sign drowning until I don't.

entries.game_text: The signature was always going to bring you back. I merely wrote the appointment you deserved.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The signature was always going to bring you back. I merely wrote the appointment you deserved.

entries.game_text: The clerk can run until dawn. You have an appointment off the ledger.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The clerk can run until dawn. You have an appointment off the ledger.

entries.game_text: The watch files what I sign. Tonight I sign nothing except your attendance.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The watch files what I sign. Tonight I sign nothing except your attendance.

entries.game_text: Meet me on Tear Drop Island. There is an inn between two geisha houses on the north side. Wear your best.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Meet me on Tear Drop Island. There is an inn between two geisha houses on the north side. Wear your best.

entries.game_text: Read the rest after you breathe.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Read the rest after you breathe.

entries.game_text: You will have the reason when you arrive hungry. Keep up, To-chan.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You will have the reason when you arrive hungry. Keep up, To-chan.

entries.game_text: Good evening, Toa san. Getting here was not too difficult?
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Good evening, Toa san. Getting here was not too difficult?

entries.game_text: Hm.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Hm.

entries.game_text: Are you hungry? Thirsty?
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [calm] Are you hungry? Thirsty?

entries.game_text: The menu is already decided.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The menu is already decided.

entries.game_text: I wanted to show you my appreciation for the work you have done for me.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I wanted to show you my appreciation for the work you have done for me.

entries.game_text: Enjoy it.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Enjoy it.

entries.game_text: I have arranged for more music and dancers should that suit your desires.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I have arranged for more music and dancers should that suit your desires.

entries.game_text: Kampai.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Kampai.

entries.game_text: Finally — a witness note I can eat.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [matter-of-fact] Finally — a witness note I can eat.

entries.game_text: I call it compensation for bolt-room competence. Do not make the quarter file poetry before dessert.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I call it compensation for bolt-room competence. Do not make the quarter file poetry before dessert.

entries.game_text: If I ever find any dance crimes I know who I need to bring with me.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [chuckles] If I ever find any dance crimes I know who I need to bring with me.

entries.game_text: Relax. Enjoy the dance. Unless watching is the fun — what could they do better?
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Relax. Enjoy the dance. Unless watching is the fun — what could they do better?

entries.game_text: Witness approved.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Witness approved.

entries.game_text: As a magistrate reads deceit.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] As a magistrate reads deceit.

entries.game_text: Well then. It seems I have learned something new.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Well then. It seems I have learned something new.

entries.game_text: And you recognize these observations are not limited to dance?
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] And you recognize these observations are not limited to dance?

entries.game_text: I know.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I know.

entries.game_text: But now you will tell me who has been saying these things. I insist.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] But now you will tell me who has been saying these things. I insist.

entries.game_text: Doji Sango san? Have we even spoken?
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Doji Sango san? Have we even spoken?

entries.game_text: If it is only two names I need to work on my image.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] If it is only two names I need to work on my image.

entries.game_text: What else has Doji Sango san said?
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] What else has Doji Sango san said?

entries.game_text: Oh, now I am very interested.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Oh, now I am very interested.

entries.game_text: I would never do that. That would be admitting defeat.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I would never do that. That would be admitting defeat.

entries.game_text: No. Do not change a thing. If servants carry it, she might as well have watchers.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] No. Do not change a thing. If servants carry it, [short pause] she might as well have watchers.

entries.game_text: Never once. You are very well loved in this city.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Never once. You are very well loved in this city.

entries.game_text: Dessert?
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [calm] Dessert?

entries.game_text: I said the city speaks well of my witness. Do not inflate the file.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] I said the city speaks well of my witness. Do not inflate the file.

entries.game_text: A date is a line on a permit book.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] A date is a line on a permit book.

entries.game_text: This is appreciation. Witness competence. Food so you do not faint on my desk tomorrow.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] This is appreciation. Witness competence. Food so you do not faint on my desk tomorrow.

entries.game_text: It is the answer the quarter deserves. You are patronage artist, woman who trusted me in the bolt room — do not borrow festival vocabulary because the sake was expensive.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] It is the answer the quarter deserves. You are patronage artist, [short pause] woman who trusted me in the bolt room — do not borrow festival vocabulary because the sake was expensive.

entries.game_text: Feel what you like in private. In public you are mine to position.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Feel what you like in private. In public you are mine to position.
[pause] [exhales] ...No.

entries.game_text: It is the closest I come before I learn better.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] It is the closest I come before I learn better.

entries.game_text: Forget the second sentence. The first sentence stands.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Forget the second sentence. The first sentence stands.

entries.game_text: No.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] No.

entries.game_text: ...It is the closest I come before I learn better.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [whispers] ...It is the closest I come before I learn better.

entries.game_text: Forget I said the second sentence. The first sentence stands.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Forget I said the second sentence. The first sentence stands.

entries.game_text: Tea. Then bed. The dock will not smell of lanterns.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Tea. Then bed. The dock will not smell of lanterns.

entries.game_text: And To-chan — do not sulk in the witness log. Sulk in private. I permit that much.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] And To-chan — do not sulk in the witness log. Sulk in private. I permit that much.

entries.game_text: Good. Cloak. No ledger. If the watch asks, you are inventory I chose not to file.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Good. Cloak. No ledger. If the watch asks, [short pause] you are inventory I chose not to file.

entries.game_text: Permits are paper. Boats are honest. Keep up, To-chan.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Permits are paper. Boats are honest. Keep up, To-chan.

entries.game_text: Can just ONE thing go right?!
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Can just ONE thing go right?!

entries.game_text: Bad day for you too?
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [calm] Bad day for you too?

entries.game_text: I'm fine. I'm just cold.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I'm fine. I'm just cold.

entries.game_text: There's no other way to get to Teardrop Island, obviously.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] There's no other way to get to Teardrop Island, obviously.

entries.game_text: Are you going to stand there, or are you going to help warm me up? Come here. It's been a bad day, and you, To-chan, get to deal with it.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Are you going to stand there, or are you going to help warm me up? Come here. It's been a bad day, [sighs] and you, To-chan, get to deal with it.

entries.game_text: Crane spine on a winter pier. Brave. Foolish. Mine either way.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Crane spine on a winter pier. Brave. Foolish. Mine either way.

entries.game_text: I asked with the boat and the bay. You are still here.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I asked with the boat and the bay. You are still here.

entries.game_text: Almost enough. But not.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Almost enough. But not.

entries.game_text: Worse.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Worse.

entries.game_text: You're on top today. I'm too cold to be on top, and you need to work through your feelings too. Get to it.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You're on top today. I'm too cold to be on top, [short pause] and you need to work through your feelings too. Get to it.

entries.game_text: Hm? Oh — I suppose that's true. Were you looking for someone like me though?
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Hm? Oh [short pause] — I suppose that's true. Were you looking for someone like me though?

entries.game_text: Mostly wondering why more women can't be like you. And eager to have a man like me bully them along.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Mostly wondering why more women can't be like you. And eager to have a man like me bully them along.

entries.game_text: Fiiiiiiiine.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Fiiiiiiiine.

entries.game_text: Toa-san? I am going to bend you over the side of the bath.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Toa-san? I am going to bend you over the side of the bath.

entries.game_text: Case Five will not wait because you bruised your knees on my kobune.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Case Five will not wait because you bruised your knees on my kobune.

entries.game_text: And To-chan — sulk in private if you must. The marina already saw enough.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] And To-chan — sulk in private if you must. The marina already saw enough.

entries.game_text: Case Five begins when the pleasure-quarter seal goes missing. Until then — witness notes sleep, not romance.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Case Five begins when the pleasure-quarter seal goes missing. Until then — witness notes sleep, [short pause] not romance.

entries.game_text: You'll knock again when hunger wins. Tonight I collect what you owed at the canal.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You'll knock again when hunger wins. Tonight I collect what you owed at the canal.

entries.game_text: There. Now you're low enough to hear terms.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] There. Now you're low enough to hear terms.

entries.game_text: Witness without obedience is gossip. Learn faster.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Witness without obedience is gossip. Learn faster.

entries.game_text: You carried my seal's work into Scorpion water and came back proud. Pride bends here.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You carried my seal's work into Scorpion water and came back proud. Pride bends here.

entries.game_text: You pushed twice at the waterline and once in my hall. I do not repeat warnings.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You pushed twice at the waterline and once in my hall. I do not repeat warnings.

entries.game_text: You are line item on my evening until I say otherwise. Desk. Now.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] You are line item on my evening until I say otherwise. Desk. Now.

entries.game_text: You wanted theater at the canal. My office is not a stage — it is a desk, a seal, and consequences.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] You wanted theater at the canal. My office is not a stage — it is a desk, [short pause] a seal, and consequences.

entries.game_text: You'll knock again when hunger wins. Tonight I collect what you owed at the chair.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You'll knock again when hunger wins. Tonight I collect what you owed at the chair.

entries.game_text: You bow when the floor meets your knees. Less talk.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You bow when the floor meets your knees — bend at the waist, courtesy bow. Less talk.

entries.game_text: Companion escort, temporary. I know what I'm paying for tonight.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Companion escort, temporary. I know what I'm paying for tonight.

entries.game_text: Watch me stamp something that isn't your renewal.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Watch me stamp something that isn't your renewal.

entries.game_text: Permit book without ink is just paper. You are still line item on my evening.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Permit book without ink is just paper. You are still line item on my evening.

entries.game_text: The watch files what I sign. You ran from my desk with wet ink on your sleeve.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] The watch files what I sign. You ran from my desk with wet ink on your sleeve.

entries.game_text: Wrong door was amusing once. I'm not amused anymore.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Wrong door was amusing once. I'm not amused anymore.

entries.game_text: You carried my permit book out. That makes you my errand until I cancel it.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You carried my permit book out. That makes you my errand until I cancel it.

entries.game_text: Desk. Now. The latch stays down until I say otherwise.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Desk. Now. The latch stays down until I say otherwise.

entries.game_text: My escort list ends at my threshold. You're still on the docket.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] My escort list ends at my threshold. You're still on the docket.

entries.game_text: I said the city has other dancers. I did not release you from my hall.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I said the city has other dancers. I did not release you from my hall.

entries.game_text: To-chan. My corridor. My hanko. You have neither.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] To-chan. My corridor. My hanko. You have neither.

entries.game_text: Case Two. The Academy expected a credential packet for Kakita Toa — charter renewal, examination waiver, the bureaucracy dancers pretend is mercy.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Case Two. The Academy expected a credential packet for Kakita Toa — charter renewal, [short pause] examination waiver, the bureaucracy dancers pretend is mercy.

entries.game_text: The courier was found in a warehouse alley with his throat cut and his satchel burned. The watch calls it robbery. The ash calls it a message.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The courier was found in a warehouse alley with his throat cut and his satchel burned. The watch calls it robbery. The ash calls it a message.

entries.game_text: You will not leave to plead with Crane clerks by post. You will find what burned, or you will pack for the road I warned you about.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You will not leave to plead with Crane clerks by post. You will find what burned, [short pause] or you will pack for the road I warned you about.

entries.game_text: Your permit survives Case One. Case Two decides whether the Academy ever hears your name again.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Your permit survives Case One. Case Two decides whether the Academy ever hears your name again.

entries.game_text: Methodical. The Academy trained something useful after all.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [warmly] Methodical. The Academy trained something useful after all.

entries.game_text: List the jealous, the indebted, and the Scorpion remnants. Case One left enemies with ash still on their cuffs.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] List the jealous, [short pause] the indebted, and the Scorpion remnants. Case One left enemies with ash still on their cuffs.

entries.game_text: Discipline. Rare. Fetch the outer-desk file and meet me at the kiln.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Discipline. Rare. Fetch the outer-desk file and meet me at the kiln.

entries.game_text: Or walked away paid. Charms cost money this far from shrines.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Or walked away paid. Charms cost money this far from shrines.

entries.game_text: Scorpion grey again. Case One's flower has not finished with us.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Scorpion grey again. Case One's flower has not finished with us.

entries.game_text: Toa, wait—
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Toa, wait—

entries.game_text: The margin reads like a clerk's hand — office ink, not warehouse soot. Someone inside my compound touched the routing before Tsubaki left.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The margin reads like a clerk's hand — office ink, [short pause] not warehouse soot. Someone inside my compound touched the routing before Tsubaki left.

entries.game_text: Factor. Scorpion. Ash. Say the rest or I'll let the kiln finish your tongue.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Factor. Scorpion. Ash. Say the rest or I'll let the kiln finish your tongue.

entries.game_text: Patient. Vicious in the right direction. I will watch the desk tonight.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Patient. Vicious in the right direction. I will watch the desk tonight.

entries.game_text: You learn. The clerk sweats because you didn't shout — that frightens him more.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You learn. The clerk sweats because you didn't shout — that frightens him more.

entries.game_text: Wise. The clerk will speak to me alone. You will listen and learn what office betrayal sounds like.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Wise. The clerk will speak to me alone. You will listen and learn what office betrayal sounds like.

entries.game_text: The Academy receives proof you are still alive, still employed, and still inconvenient. That buys you the season.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The Academy receives proof you are still alive, [short pause] still employed, and still inconvenient. That buys you the season.

entries.game_text: You burned a clerk's cover in public. Effective — and expensive. The office will gossip for weeks.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You burned a clerk's cover in public. Effective — and expensive. The office will gossip for weeks.

entries.game_text: Your decoy caught a rat. The rat will lead us back to the Chrysanthemum's ledger — Case One's flower isn't finished blooming.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Your decoy caught a rat. The rat will lead us back to the Chrysanthemum's ledger — Case One's flower isn't finished blooming.

entries.game_text: Tonight you sleep. Tomorrow Case Three arrives whether we invite it or not.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Tonight you sleep. Tomorrow Case Three arrives whether we invite it or not.

entries.game_text: The outer clerk can guard ash until dawn. You are coming to the hill festival. Consider it a field inspection of morale.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The outer clerk can guard ash until dawn. You are coming to the hill festival. Consider it a field inspection of morale.

entries.game_text: The watch files what I sign. Tonight I sign nothing except your attendance. Bring your appetite — the curry stall by the lower bridge owes me a debt.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The watch files what I sign. Tonight I sign nothing except your attendance. Bring your appetite — the curry stall by the lower bridge owes me a debt.

entries.game_text: Correct. Keep up, To-chan.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Correct. Keep up, To-chan.

entries.game_text: Sit. The hill is mine by tax map and by habit. No clerk will petition you here.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Sit. The hill is mine by tax map and by habit. No clerk will petition you here.

entries.game_text: Kind is what merchants sell when the ledger is honest for one night. Enjoy the lie. It is cheaper than virtue.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Kind is what merchants sell when the ledger is honest for one night. Enjoy the lie. It is cheaper than virtue.

entries.game_text: One night. I know how you count.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] One night. I know how you count.

entries.game_text: Let them watch the sky. I am watching you remember you are still alive after ash.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] Let them watch the sky. I am watching you remember you are still alive after ash.

entries.game_text: Enough. Don't file that under promises.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Enough. Don't file that under promises.

entries.game_text: A festival kiss is paper confetti — pretty, public, worthless in the morning docket. You will not read my mouth like a charter.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] A festival kiss is paper confetti — pretty, [short pause] public, worthless in the morning docket. You will not read my mouth like a charter.

entries.game_text: Good. Then we descend before the watch invents a rumor worth selling.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Good. Then we descend before the watch invents a rumor worth selling.

entries.game_text: Walk. Curry before curfew. Case Three will not wait because you blushed on a bench.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Walk. Curry before curfew. Case Three will not wait because you blushed on a bench.

entries.game_text: Then you choose a door I already hold. Guest room on the descent — one screen, one lock, my corridor.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] Then you choose a door I already hold. Guest room on the descent — one screen, [short pause] one lock, my corridor.

entries.game_text: Dangerous request from my companion. I will allow it until the wax cools.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Dangerous request from my companion. I will allow it until the wax cools.

entries.game_text: You will not thank me with poetry. Feed yourself before Case Three drags you back to witness notes.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] You will not thank me with poetry. Feed yourself before Case Three drags you back to witness notes.

entries.game_text: The city pretends every night. I remember what I pay for.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The city pretends every night. I remember what I pay for.

entries.game_text: Sleep while you can. The next file will not smell of fireworks.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Sleep while you can. The next file will not smell of fireworks.

entries.game_text: It will not wait. Neither will I — when it knocks, you answer beside me.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] It will not wait. Neither will I — when it knocks, you answer beside me.

entries.game_text: The Academy thinks you're still respectable. I think you're still mine to complicate.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] The Academy thinks you're still respectable. I think you're still mine to complicate.

entries.game_text: You kept both. That is rarer than virtue here.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You kept both. That is rarer than virtue here.

entries.game_text: Too late. Case Three will hurt worse. I'll be beside you when it does — if you keep choosing me over the door.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] Too late. Case Three will hurt worse. I'll be beside you when it does — if you keep choosing me over the door.

entries.game_text: Case Three. The Chrysanthemum factor from Case One did not vanish with the barge. His cousin trades kimono under a Crane front name — bolt counts that do not match tax lines.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Case Three. The Chrysanthemum factor from Case One did not vanish with the barge. His cousin trades kimono under a Crane front name — bolt counts that do not match tax lines.

entries.game_text: Civilized is how this city hides knives. You wanted a witness note that survives clerks. You will earn it in the bolt room or lose it on my desk.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [matter-of-fact] Civilized is how this city hides knives. You wanted a witness note that survives clerks. You will earn it in the bolt room or lose it on my desk.

entries.game_text: You sleep adjoining my office. Today you walk the shop beside me — not ahead, not alone.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You sleep adjoining my office. Today you walk the shop beside me — not ahead, [short pause] not alone.

entries.game_text: Tea cooled yesterday. The file did not.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Tea cooled yesterday. The file did not.

entries.game_text: Your permit survived Case Two. Case Three decides whether anyone in the Academy still believes your name.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Your permit survived Case Two. Case Three decides whether anyone in the Academy still believes your name.

entries.game_text: Arithmetic. Rare in dancers. Bring me a line I can paste without crossing out your adjectives.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Arithmetic. Rare in dancers. Bring me a line I can paste without crossing out your adjectives.

entries.game_text: Discipline. Ask who profits if a bolt room collapses on a Crane witness.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Discipline. Ask who profits if a bolt room collapses on a Crane witness.

entries.game_text: Then do not braid poetry on my desk. Tag, bag, witness.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Then do not braid poetry on my desk. Tag, bag, witness.

entries.game_text: Magistrate custody. Open the bolt room. No one touches the top shelf until my witness signs the count.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Magistrate custody. Open the bolt room. No one touches the top shelf until my witness signs the count.

entries.game_text: Because someone wanted inventory to fall when the right person stood underneath. Ask your questions. I will be at the street door — close enough to hear you scream, far enough that clerks think you are still alone.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Because someone wanted inventory to fall when the right person stood underneath. Ask your questions. I will be at the street door — close enough to hear you scream, [short pause] far enough that clerks think you are still alone.

entries.game_text: I am giving you a clerk who will talk to a dancer and lie to a magistrate. Use it.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I am giving you a clerk who will talk to a dancer and lie to a magistrate. Use it.

entries.game_text: Up. Now. Before the clerk invents a story where you died clumsy.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Up. Now. Before the clerk invents a story where you died clumsy.

entries.game_text: Draft in the alley. Nerves. Stand.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Draft in the alley. Nerves. Stand.

entries.game_text: If you had died in my bolt room I would have burned this quarter to the canal.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] If you had died in my bolt room I would have burned this quarter to the canal.

entries.game_text: Forget I said it. Witness note: shelf sabotage. Clerk detained. You breathe — that is the only romance the file requires.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [matter-of-fact] Forget I said it. Witness note: shelf sabotage. Clerk detained. You breathe — that is the only romance the file requires.

entries.game_text: Good. Devotion belongs on paper until I say otherwise.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Good. Devotion belongs on paper until I say otherwise.

entries.game_text: Case Three is not closed. It is pinned — like the bolt that almost killed my witness.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Case Three is not closed. It is pinned — like the bolt that almost killed my witness.

entries.game_text: The mis-tagged lot ties back to Case One's flower. Good. Paste that line before a Scorpion lawyer buys the clerk's silence.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] The mis-tagged lot ties back to Case One's flower. Good. Paste that line before a Scorpion lawyer buys the clerk's silence.

entries.game_text: I was at the mat, not the door. Do not make poetry of it. Case Four will knock when the rain returns.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I was at the mat, [short pause] not the door. Do not make poetry of it. Case Four will knock when the rain returns.

entries.game_text: Case Four begins where paper runs to steel. Raid the lower dock. Bring me Kurogane or bring me blood.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Case Four begins where paper runs to steel. Raid the lower dock. Bring me Kurogane or bring me blood.

entries.game_text: Tonight you are both. Stay in my line or the file learns you did not.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Tonight you are both. Stay in my line or the file learns you did not.

entries.game_text: Case Four. Kurogane runs the split crates our clerk fled toward. He trained under a Scorpion quartermaster. He will not surrender to ink.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Case Four. Kurogane runs the split crates our clerk fled toward. He trained under a Scorpion quartermaster. He will not surrender to ink.

entries.game_text: Steel. You dance with a blade when I say dance. You do not duel a foreman alone.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Steel. You dance with a blade when I say dance. You do not duel a foreman alone.

entries.game_text: You breathed in my bolt room. Tonight you breathe in my line — or the ledger learns you did not.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You breathed in my bolt room. Tonight you breathe in my line — or the ledger learns you did not.

entries.game_text: Correct. You are witness with a wakizashi. Walk like you know the difference.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Correct. You are witness with a wakizashi. Walk like you know the difference.

entries.game_text: Three breaths. Read the room. Then we take him.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Three breaths. Read the room. Then we take him.

entries.game_text: Paste that before steel speaks.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Paste that before steel speaks.

entries.game_text: Good. Name him again when his blade clears the sheath.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Good. Name him again when his blade clears the sheath.

entries.game_text: Discipline. Rare in dancers.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Discipline. Rare in dancers.

entries.game_text: Kurogane! Emerald custody — lower your blade or lower your head.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Kurogane! Emerald custody — lower your blade or lower your head.

entries.game_text: [case4_suspect_name]! Emerald custody — lower your blade or lower your head.
entries.tts_text: [case4_suspect_name] [calm] ! Emerald custody — lower your blade or lower your head.

entries.game_text: Toa — line!
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Toa — line!

entries.game_text: Breathe. Count. You are still mine to file.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] Breathe. Count. You are still mine to file.

entries.game_text: If you had died on my dock I would have burned this pier to the canal.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] If you had died on my dock I would have burned this pier to the canal.

entries.game_text: Forget I said it. Witness note: foreman detained. Ledger seized. You breathe — that is the only romance the file requires tonight.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [matter-of-fact] Forget I said it. Witness note: foreman detained. Ledger seized. You breathe — that is the only romance the file requires tonight.

entries.game_text: Case Four is pinned, not closed. The flower still has roots.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Case Four is pinned, not closed. The flower still has roots.

entries.game_text: You stayed in my line when steel wanted you alone. Do not expect applause — expect a pleasure-quarter seal stolen by morning.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You stayed in my line when steel wanted you alone. Do not expect applause — expect a pleasure-quarter seal stolen by morning.

entries.game_text: Because is a word for Case Five. Tonight you sleep.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Because is a word for Case Five. Tonight you sleep.

entries.game_text: I like you. So much so that I want to keep you around.
entries.tts_text: [warmly] [calm] I like you. So much so that I want to keep you around.

entries.game_text: You ask for my desk in front of a drowning clerk and a Miya witness. Stupid, To-chan. Mine.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] You ask for my desk in front of a drowning clerk and a Miya witness. Stupid, [short pause] To-chan. Mine.

entries.game_text: Office. My corridor. We're not finished when you decide we're finished.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Office. My corridor. We're not finished when you decide we're finished.

entries.game_text: You asked for closed screens twice in one night. You will have them.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] You asked for closed screens twice in one night. You will have them.

entries.game_text: Desk. Now. Before you mistake appetite for permission again.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Desk. Now. Before you mistake appetite for permission again.

entries.game_text: Empty witness note. Blank collar line. You do not get another hour.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Empty witness note. Blank collar line. You do not get another hour.

entries.game_text: Desk. You will learn what my hall costs when you arrive with nothing to sign.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Desk. You will learn what my hall costs when you arrive with nothing to sign.

entries.game_text: Lantern light pools on polished floorboards. Every sliding door looks the same.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Lantern light pools on polished floorboards. Every sliding door looks the same.

entries.game_text: Toa clutches her permit book and hanko case, turning in a corridor that refuses to end.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Toa clutches her permit book and hanko case, [short pause] turning in a corridor that refuses to end.

entries.game_text: The noble quarter smells of ink and cedar. Somewhere behind these walls, someone holds the seal she needs.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] The noble quarter smells of ink and cedar. Somewhere behind these walls, [short pause] someone holds the seal she needs.

entries.game_text: The door shuts with finality. Toa's ears ring.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [whispers] The door shuts with finality. Toa's ears ring.

entries.game_text: Toa straightens her kosode, breathes, and waits.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Toa straightens her kosode, breathes, and waits.

entries.game_text: Three offices later, a junior clerk squints at her permit book and points back the way she came.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Three offices later, [short pause] a junior clerk squints at her permit book and points back the way she came.

entries.game_text: The corridor loops — of course it loops — and deposits her exactly where she started.
entries.tts_text: [pause] The corridor loops [dramatic] of course it loops — and deposits her exactly where she started.

entries.game_text: Toa folds her hands. No muttering. No pacing. Just breath and patience.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Toa folds her hands. No muttering. No pacing. Just breath and patience.

entries.game_text: Toa kneels at the threshold and strikes the frame once — crisp, patient.
entries.tts_text: [pause] Toa kneels at the threshold and strikes the frame once [dramatic] crisp, patient.

entries.game_text: Toa kneels at the threshold and strikes the frame twice — crisp, measured.
entries.tts_text: [pause] Toa kneels at the threshold and strikes the frame twice [dramatic] crisp, [short pause] measured.

entries.game_text: He gestures. The door closes behind her.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] He gestures. The door closes behind her.

entries.game_text: Toa keeps her gaze on the desk. Not on the shelves lined with case files and curios.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Toa keeps her gaze on the desk. Not on the shelves lined with case files and curios.

entries.game_text: Her eyes snag on a row of scrolls — Lion mon here, Emerald seal there—
entries.tts_text: [pause] Her eyes snag on a row of scrolls [dramatic] Lion mon here, Emerald seal there—

entries.game_text: A cushion already waits on the tatami at his knee. He taps it once with one finger. A tall cup of water on the desk waits like a witness.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] A cushion already waits on the tatami at his knee. He taps it once with one finger. A tall cup of water on the desk waits like a witness.

entries.game_text: Toa sets her permit book and hanko case on the desk — close enough to show, not close enough to surrender.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] Toa sets her permit book and hanko case on the desk — close enough to show, [short pause] not close enough to surrender.

entries.game_text: He tutted once. Toa has heard he can manage five.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] He tutted once. Toa has heard he can manage five.

entries.game_text: The cushion at her feet does not move. The water cup on the desk does not move. It never does.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] The cushion at her feet does not move. The water cup on the desk does not move. It never does.

entries.game_text: She gathers her permit book. The hanko case clicks shut like a verdict.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] She gathers her permit book. The hanko case clicks shut like a verdict.

entries.game_text: Rain finds the noble quarter anyway. Case One will have to wait for a braver night.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] Rain finds the noble quarter anyway. Case One will have to wait for a braver night.

entries.game_text: Lamplight shrinks the room. Toa loosens her obi — not indecent, but deliberate — and lets the silk breathe.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] Lamplight shrinks the room. Toa loosens her obi — not indecent, [short pause] but deliberate — and lets the silk breathe.

entries.game_text: She unfolds her fan. Steps trace a story — courtship, hesitation, resolve — obijime bells whispering at each turn.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] She unfolds her fan. Steps trace a story — courtship, [short pause] hesitation, resolve — obijime bells whispering at each turn.

entries.game_text: Kaoru watches, still as stone. He drinks water without looking away.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Kaoru watches, still as stone. He drinks water without looking away.

entries.game_text: The fan closes on the final beat — not a bow, but a held breath.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] The fan closes on the final beat [pause] not a courtesy bow, but a held breath.

entries.game_text: She plays to one viewer. Hips sway where the kata allows; smile promises more than the room receives.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] She plays to one viewer. Hips sway where the kata allows; [short pause] smile promises more than the room receives.

entries.game_text: She lets the obijime bells laugh once — invitation and challenge in the same sound.
entries.tts_text: [pause] She lets the obijime bells laugh once [dramatic] invitation and challenge in the same sound.

entries.game_text: The cup sets down softly. His eyes don't blink.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] The cup sets down softly. His eyes don't blink.

entries.game_text: She continues — the maiden's story unfinished, bells softer now, every turn aimed at the desk.
entries.tts_text: [pause] She continues [dramatic] the maiden's story unfinished, [short pause] bells softer now, every turn aimed at the desk.

entries.game_text: She continues — coquette sway sharpened to obedience, every glance a question he refuses to answer.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] She continues — coquette sway sharpened to obedience, [short pause] every glance a question he refuses to answer.

entries.game_text: She continues — bells softer, gaze sharper, every turn aimed at the desk and the seal he still withholds.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] She continues — bells softer, [short pause] gaze sharper, every turn aimed at the desk and the seal he still withholds.

entries.game_text: His hand finds her wrist — not painful, not gentle. Entitlement dressed as appraisal.
entries.tts_text: [pause] His hand finds her wrist [dramatic] not painful, [short pause] not gentle. Entitlement dressed as appraisal.

entries.game_text: She spins free and finishes the phrase — defiance as choreography.
entries.tts_text: [pause] She spins free and finishes the phrase [dramatic] defiance as choreography.

entries.game_text: She doesn't pull away. The dance uses his grip as counterweight — dangerous, deliberate.
entries.tts_text: [pause] She doesn't pull away. The dance uses his grip as counterweight [dramatic] dangerous, [short pause] deliberate.

entries.game_text: The chair creaks. Hakama folds. Power imbalance made visible — two figures, one question hanging.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] The chair creaks. Hakama folds. Power imbalance made visible — two figures, [short pause] one question hanging.

entries.game_text: She straddles the chair's arm — not surrender, not retreat. Proximity as punctuation.
entries.tts_text: [pause] She straddles the chair's arm [dramatic] not surrender, [short pause] not retreat. Proximity as punctuation.

entries.game_text: He lifts the hanko — teasing height above the permit book — then sets it down untouched.
entries.tts_text: [pause] He lifts the hanko [dramatic] teasing height above the permit book — then sets it down untouched.

entries.game_text: The corridor is colder than the office. Somewhere a bell marks the hour — not dawn, not yet.
entries.tts_text: [pause] The corridor is colder than the office. Somewhere a bell marks the hour [dramatic] not dawn, [short pause] not yet.

entries.game_text: She snatches the permit book. The hanko case stays — his, or forgotten, or a trap she refuses to spring.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] She snatches the permit book. The hanko case stays — his, [short pause] or forgotten, or a trap she refuses to spring.

entries.game_text: Lantern light stripes the floor. Her boots echo too loud for the noble quarter.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Lantern light stripes the floor. Her boots echo too loud for the noble quarter.

entries.game_text: She turns the corner too fast. Behind her, boots do not hurry — they count.
entries.tts_text: [pause] She turns the corner too fast. Behind her, [short pause] boots do not hurry [dramatic] they count.

entries.game_text: She runs for the outer gate. Lacquer and iron have not opened for petitioners this late — only for magistrates who forgot to lock shame inside.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] She runs for the outer gate. Lacquer and iron have not opened for petitioners this late — only for magistrates who forgot to lock shame inside.

entries.game_text: The gate bars are down. Night watchmen pretend not to hear. They know whose seal buys silence in this quarter.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] The gate bars are down. Night watchmen pretend not to hear. They know whose seal buys silence in this quarter.

entries.game_text: His hand closes on her wrist — not a lover's grip, a clerk's. Fingers find the pulse the way he finds a misplaced line.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] His hand closes on her wrist — not a lover's grip, [short pause] a clerk's. Fingers find the pulse the way he finds a misplaced line.

entries.game_text: He hauls her back through the corridor the way a seal returns to its case — boots skidding on polished wood, lantern stripes racing across her face.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] He hauls her back through the corridor the way a seal returns to its case — boots skidding on polished wood, [short pause] lantern stripes racing across her face.

entries.game_text: Red wax blooms under his hanko — not on her permit, but on a narrow custody chit he had waiting.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] Red wax blooms under his hanko — not on her permit, [short pause] but on a narrow custody chit he had waiting.

entries.game_text: The guest-room mat. The cushion she refused to preview. The docket stack still warm where she flung her pride.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] The guest-room mat. The cushion she refused to preview. The docket stack still warm where she flung her pride.

entries.game_text: He turns — not in haste, but enough. Her shoulder meets air where his sleeve was.
entries.tts_text: [pause] He turns [dramatic] not in haste, [short pause] but enough. Her shoulder meets air where his sleeve was.

entries.game_text: The mat rushes up. Paper scatters like startled herons. The permit book skids under the desk where he wanted it in the first place.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] The mat rushes up. Paper scatters like startled herons. The permit book skids under the desk where he wanted it in the first place.

entries.game_text: Her arms do not answer. Pride was a costume. Under it she is only breath and bruised obi and the taste of his corridor.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Her arms do not answer. Pride was a costume. Under it she is only breath and bruised obi and the taste of his corridor.

entries.game_text: The office door seals. Lamplight shrinks to a strip under the shoji.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] The office door seals. Lamplight shrinks to a strip under the shoji.

entries.game_text: From the hall, clerks hear nothing — or learn to hear nothing. Emerald Magistrate business.
entries.tts_text: [pause] From the hall, [short pause] clerks hear nothing [dramatic] or learn to hear nothing. Emerald Magistrate business.

entries.game_text: What happens next is not entered in any clerk's ledger — only in the ache she will carry if she survives the night.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] What happens next is not entered in any clerk's ledger — only in the ache she will carry if she survives the night.

entries.game_text: The latch catches. Lamplight thins to amber behind the desk.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] The latch catches. Lamplight thins to amber behind the desk.

entries.game_text: His hand finds her wrist — not restraint, invitation. He draws her off the chair and into the space between desk and lantern.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] His hand finds her wrist — not restraint, [short pause] invitation. He draws her off the chair and into the space between desk and lantern.

entries.game_text: Negotiation dissolves into breath. Her fingers find his collar; his thumb traces the line of her jaw.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Negotiation dissolves into breath. Her fingers find his collar; [short pause] his thumb traces the line of her jaw.

entries.game_text: She loosens the gold outer robe — magistrate formality giving way to skin at throat and collarbone. He lets her. Control, yielded by degrees.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] She loosens the gold outer robe — magistrate formality giving way to skin at throat and collarbone. He lets her. Control, [short pause] yielded by degrees.

entries.game_text: Maroon silk slips from one shoulder. Her obi loosens; his hakama stays untouched — hers the offering, his the permission.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] Maroon silk slips from one shoulder. Her obi loosens; his hakama stays untouched — hers the offering, [short pause] his the permission.

entries.game_text: They fold onto the cushion already on the tatami. Lamplight paints them in gold and shadow — breath shared, his hands in white hair, her mouth at his collar until words fail.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] They fold onto the cushion already on the tatami. Lamplight paints them in gold and shadow — breath shared, [short pause] his hands in white hair, her mouth at his collar until words fail.

entries.game_text: She means it. He answers without words — hands in white hair, silk between them, heat where law used to sit.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] She means it. He answers without words — hands in white hair, [short pause] silk between them, heat where law used to sit.

entries.game_text: What followed stayed between petitioner and magistrate — implied, never entered in any clerk's ledger.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] What followed stayed between petitioner and magistrate — implied, [short pause] never entered in any clerk's ledger.

entries.game_text: When breath and silk found order again, robes still loose and cheeks flushed, the office smelled of ink and cedar, not scandal.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] When breath and silk found order again, [short pause] robes still loose and cheeks flushed, the office smelled of ink and cedar, not scandal.

entries.game_text: He draws the renewal from her permit book. The hanko rises — law made weight in red wax.
entries.tts_text: [pause] He draws the renewal from her permit book. The hanko rises [dramatic] law made weight in red wax.

entries.game_text: Stamp. One crisp press against the page.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Stamp. One crisp press against the page.

entries.game_text: She holds the paper to the lamp. His hand wrote three days hence — not tonight's mark.
entries.tts_text: [pause] She holds the paper to the lamp. His hand wrote three days hence [dramatic] not tonight's mark.

entries.game_text: Morning in the noble quarter tastes of ink and cedar. The thirtieth is still on the permit — but Toa is already at the threshold with tea and a borrowed case file.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] Morning in the noble quarter tastes of ink and cedar. The thirtieth is still on the permit — but Toa is already at the threshold with tea and a borrowed case file.

entries.game_text: He gestures to the cushion on the tatami before the desk — the same place he made her sit for her audition.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] He gestures to the cushion on the tatami before the desk — the same place he made her sit for her audition.

entries.game_text: He slides a stack across the desk — not her permit book this time, but office stationery stamped with the Emerald crest.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] He slides a stack across the desk — not her permit book this time, [short pause] but office stationery stamped with the Emerald crest.

entries.game_text: The top sheet is titled Appointment of Live-In Companion (Patronage of Artistic Residence). Her name is already inked in his hand.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] The top sheet is titled Appointment of Live-In Companion (Patronage of Artistic Residence). Her name is already inked in his hand.

entries.game_text: He taps a second page — stipend figures, duty rotations, a line for her seal beside his.
entries.tts_text: [pause] He taps a second page [dramatic] stipend figures, [short pause] duty rotations, a line for her seal beside his.

entries.game_text: She takes the brush. Her seal meets his — waxless, official, irrevocable until he says otherwise.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] She takes the brush. Her seal meets his — waxless, [short pause] official, irrevocable until he says otherwise.

entries.game_text: The inner screen slides. Beyond it, stairs smell of old paper and river damp — the archive where Case One waits.
