entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] The inner screen slides. Beyond it, [short pause] stairs smell of old paper and river damp — the archive where Case One waits.

entries.game_text: A live-in companion appointment waits in draft on his desk — unsigned, unoffered on this timeline. Case One opens without the patronage seal.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] A live-in companion appointment waits in draft on his desk — unsigned, [short pause] unoffered on this timeline. Case One opens without the patronage seal.

entries.game_text: The left stair behind the inner screen swallows sound. Dust clings to Toa's hakama; the ledger under her arm smells of river damp and old ink.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] The left stair behind the inner screen swallows sound. Dust clings to Toa's hakama; [short pause] the ledger under her arm smells of river damp and old ink.

entries.game_text: At the top step, lantern light returns. The noble quarter corridor feels narrower with a magistrate waiting.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] At the top step, [short pause] lantern light returns. The noble quarter corridor feels narrower with a magistrate waiting.

entries.game_text: She climbs back from the archive with the canal docket hugged to her chest. No adjoining chamber waits — only Kaoru's desk and a week to prove she belongs.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] She climbs back from the archive with the canal docket hugged to her chest. No adjoining chamber waits — only Kaoru's desk and a week to prove she belongs.

entries.tts_text: [pause] [calm] Kaoru breaks the outer seal. Inside: reports from the watch, [short pause] a charcoal sketch of the recovery site, and a name line left blank pending identification.

entries.game_text: They leave through the inner hall — not the public corridor Toa once wandered lost. Guards nod at Kaoru; they look through Toa as if she were furniture with legs.

entries.game_text: Lower piers — tar ropes, split crates, wrong-green canal breath. Lanterns gutter in rain. The warehouse mouth swallows sound.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] Lower piers [exhales sharply] — tar ropes, [short pause] split crates, wrong-green canal breath. Lanterns gutter in rain. The warehouse mouth swallows sound.

entries.game_text: A foreman steps from crate shadow — katana already drawn, rain streaming off Scorpion-trained shoulders. He does not bow.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] A foreman steps from crate shadow [exhales sharply] — katana already drawn, [short pause] rain streaming off Scorpion-trained shoulders. He does not bow.

entries.game_text: Three blades in rain — Kaoru's katana a clean arc, Toa's dance-line wakizashi, Kurogane's Scorpion cut trying to split them. Crate wood splinters. Footing is blood-slick tar.

entries.game_text: She drops back — one step, not cowardice. Kaoru crosses her line without looking; his coat takes the foreman's edge where her obi would have torn.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] She drops back — one step, [short pause] not cowardice. Kaoru crosses her line without looking; his coat takes the foreman's edge where her obi would have torn.

entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] By dawn the foreman's manifest sits in custody beside Case Three's saw kerf. The clerk's runner has not vanished — only gone quiet, [short pause] which in Ryoko Owari is its own confession.

entries.game_text: Rain beads on the canal rope. The clerk studies his wax tablet. Kaoru's hand closes on her elbow — escort, not comfort — and the compound swallows them.
entries.tts_text: [pause] [dramatic] Rain beads on the canal rope. The clerk studies his wax tablet. Kaoru's hand closes on her elbow — escort, [short pause] not comfort — and the compound swallows them.

entries.game_text: I was sure the clerk said third hall, fourth door on the left. Or was it the right?
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] I was sure the clerk said third hall, [short pause] fourth door on the left. Or was it the right?

entries.game_text: One more corridor. Then I ask nicely. Very nicely.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [excited] One more corridor. Then I ask nicely. Very nicely.

entries.game_text: I wasn't— That is, I apologize for the disturbance, sochira-no-kata!
entries.tts_text: [nervously] I wasn't— [short pause] That is, I apologize for the disturbance, sochira-no-kata!

entries.game_text: Third time's the charm. Or the magistrate. Hopefully both.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Third time's the charm. Or the magistrate. Hopefully both.

entries.game_text: Fine. I'll find a magistrate with better manners.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Fine. I'll find a magistrate with better manners.

entries.game_text: The Emerald Magistrate? That door?
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] The Emerald Magistrate? That door?

entries.game_text: I've come too far to be scared off by a reputation.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] I've come too far to be scared off by a reputation.

entries.game_text: Every sign points back to this door. Of course it does.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [short pause] Every sign points back to this door. Of course it does.

entries.game_text: Round two. Posture up. Smile optional.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [defiant] Round two. Posture up. Smile optional.

entries.game_text: Honored sochira-no-kata, this unworthy petitioner begs a moment regarding her performer's permit renewal.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Honored sochira-no-kata, [short pause] this unworthy petitioner begs a moment regarding her performer's permit renewal.

entries.game_text: Magistrate — I need my permit renewed. I have the paperwork.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Magistrate [short pause] — I need my permit renewed. I have the paperwork.

entries.game_text: I promise I'm only lost geographically, not legally. May I present my renewal request?
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] I promise I'm only lost geographically, [short pause] not legally. May I present my renewal request?

entries.game_text: Crane training says brave. Unicorn roads say stupid is survivable.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [short pause] Crane training says brave. Unicorn roads say stupid is survivable.

entries.game_text: Forgive me — Emerald Magistrate.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [warmly] Forgive me — Emerald Magistrate.

entries.game_text: Kakita Toa, dancer of the Kakita family. New to Ryoko Owari.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Kakita Toa, dancer of the Kakita family. New to Ryoko Owari.

entries.game_text: Post-gempukku, traveling from Unicorn lands. I mean to establish residence and perform legally.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Post-gempukku, [short pause] traveling from Unicorn lands. I mean to establish residence and perform legally.

entries.game_text: The roads taught me flexibility. The Crane taught me posture.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [short pause] The roads taught me flexibility. The Crane taught me posture.

entries.game_text: I was told a private meeting with the local magistrate would suffice.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] I was told a private meeting with the local magistrate would suffice.

entries.game_text: Yes, Magistrate.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Yes, Magistrate.

entries.game_text: They should be current. I checked before leaving—
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [short pause] They should be current. I checked before leaving—

entries.game_text: If I cannot renew locally, they'll send me back to the Academy. I can't— not yet.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [short pause] If I cannot renew locally, [short pause] they'll send me back to the Academy. I can't— not yet.

entries.game_text: If that is the law, I'll... prepare for the journey back.
entries.tts_text: [short pause] [whispers] If that is the law, I'll [short pause] ... prepare for the journey back.

entries.game_text: The Crane taught me to know when a battle isn't worth the obi.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [pause] The Crane taught me to know when a battle isn't worth the obi.

entries.game_text: There must be a remedy short of exile. Emerald Magistrate, what do you require?
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] There must be a remedy short of exile. Emerald Magistrate, [short pause] what do you require?

entries.game_text: Almost is a start. I dance for a living — I know how to build toward a finale.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [short pause] Almost is a start. I dance for a living [short pause] — I know how to build toward a finale.

entries.game_text: I have no patrons here. No standing. If you turn me out, I sleep in the canal district.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] I have no patrons here. No standing. If you turn me out, [short pause] I sleep in the canal district.

entries.game_text: My pony needs shoes. The innkeeper tolerates me because I fold linens without complaint.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [short pause] My pony needs shoes. The innkeeper tolerates me because I fold linens without complaint.

entries.game_text: I'm still here. That counts for something.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] I'm still here. That counts for something.

entries.game_text: Only the inn, a pony that needs shoes, and a curry shop where the owner tolerates me.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Only the inn, [short pause] a pony that needs shoes, and a curry shop where the owner tolerates me.

entries.game_text: It's March twenty-sixth. By tomorrow I need proof I belong here.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] It's March twenty-sixth. By tomorrow I need proof I belong here.

entries.game_text: I... may have listed dance as my primary art. On the renewal form.
entries.tts_text: [short pause] [dramatic] I [short pause] ... may have listed dance as my primary art. On the renewal form.

entries.game_text: I have training. I have—
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [short pause] I have training. I have—

entries.game_text: You want a performance.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] You want a performance.

entries.game_text: If I perform, you sign. No delays, no new conditions after.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] If I perform, you sign. No delays, no new conditions after.

entries.game_text: Then I'll dance until you're satisfied or until dawn breaks my ankles.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [excited] Then I'll dance until you're satisfied or until dawn breaks my ankles.

entries.game_text: Music optional. Audience of one. Watch closely, Magistrate.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Music optional. Audience of one. Watch closely, Magistrate.

entries.game_text: I'm a petitioner, not your evening entertainment.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] I'm a petitioner, not your evening entertainment.

entries.game_text: Justice isn't a private show for magistrates with bored eyes.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [whispers] Justice isn't a private show for magistrates with bored eyes.

entries.game_text: I'll find another seal. Or another city.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] I'll find another seal. Or another city.

entries.game_text: Fine. One dance. One seal. Then I never perform for you again.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] Fine. One dance. One seal. Then I never perform for you again.

entries.game_text: Snacks first was the plan. Pride second. I got the order wrong.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Snacks first was the plan. [chuckles] Pride second. I got the order wrong.

entries.game_text: The maiden waits at the gate. The road is long. She walks anyway.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [short pause] The maiden waits at the gate. The road is long. She walks anyway.

entries.game_text: One person in the room. Might as well make him regret looking away.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [excited] One person in the room. Might as well make him regret looking away.

entries.game_text: That earns your seal. You said impress you — I did.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] That earns your seal. You said impress you [short pause] — I did.

entries.game_text: We had terms. No delays.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] We had terms. No delays.

entries.game_text: Pending?
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Pending?

entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama. That is not in any permit renewal I read.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [warmly] Magistrate-sama. That is not in any permit renewal I read.

entries.game_text: I'm here for a seal, not a leash.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] I'm here for a seal, not a leash.

entries.game_text: If you're going to hold me, hold me like you mean the audition.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [warmly] If you're going to hold me, hold me like you mean the audition.

entries.game_text: Unless you sign before dawn. Unless Ryoko Owari becomes mine to dance in — legally.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [warmly] Unless you sign before dawn. Unless Ryoko Owari becomes mine to dance in — legally.

entries.game_text: Unless I find a magistrate who reads dates instead of moods. Good evening.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [whispers] Unless I find a magistrate who reads dates instead of moods. Good evening.

entries.game_text: And with my feet, when the dance required it. Sign the page, Magistrate-sama.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] And with my feet, [short pause] when the dance required it. Sign the page, Magistrate-sama.

entries.game_text: That isn't justice. It's just cruelty, and you know it.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] That isn't justice. It's just cruelty, and you know it.

entries.game_text: I gave you the performance. I named my price. What more—
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] I gave you the performance. I named my price. What more—

entries.game_text: I'll be back. With a better argument and dry obijime.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [short pause] I'll be back. With a better argument and dry obijime.

entries.game_text: Three weeks. I can survive three weeks on curry and pride.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Three weeks. I can survive three weeks on curry and pride.

entries.game_text: Snacks first. Justice second. I can hold that order for three weeks.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Snacks first. [chuckles] Justice second. I can hold that order for three weeks.

entries.game_text: I came for a seal, not a lesson in your appetite.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] I came for a seal, not a lesson in your appetite.

entries.game_text: Wrong door once was a mistake. I won't make it a habit.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [cheerfully] Wrong door once was a mistake. I won't make it a habit.

entries.game_text: Guest room previews and forward-dated seals can wait. I still have pride.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] Guest room previews and forward-dated seals can wait. I still have pride.

entries.game_text: ...And a curry shop that doesn't ask questions.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] [short pause] ...And a curry shop that doesn't ask questions.

entries.game_text: Then sign. Before I lose my nerve and my obi in the same breath.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Then [exhales] sign. Before I lose my nerve and my obi in the same breath.

entries.game_text: Thank you— wait. This date.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [excited] Thank you— wait. This date.

entries.game_text: You dated it forward on purpose.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] You dated it forward on purpose.

entries.game_text: Fine. I'll bring rice crackers and a better fan dance.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [chuckles] Fine. I'll bring rice crackers and a better fan dance.

entries.game_text: Guest room preview, forward-dated paperwork, and you call it negotiable.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] Guest room preview, forward-dated paperwork, and you call it negotiable.

entries.game_text: The permit says I'm legal on the thirtieth. I'm early with tea and a case file.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] The permit says I'm legal on the thirtieth. I'm early with tea and a case file.

entries.game_text: Snacks after paperwork. That's still the order of operations.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [short pause] Snacks after paperwork. [chuckles] That's still the order of operations.

entries.game_text: I'll save the bells for evidence review.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] I'll save the bells for evidence review.

entries.game_text: Case file, tea, and — if I'm very good — a rice cracker. Ready when you are.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Case file, tea, and — if I'm very good — a rice cracker. [chuckles] Ready when you are.

entries.game_text: The permit still expires. Some of us read dates.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] The permit still expires. Some of us read dates.

entries.game_text: Progress would be signing without games.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Progress would be signing without games.

entries.game_text: I learned you drink water when you're impressed.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] I learned you drink water when you're impressed.

entries.game_text: I also learned your terms shift. Case One gets written terms.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] I also learned your terms shift. Case One gets written terms.

entries.game_text: Then watch closely. Audience of one.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [excited] Then watch closely. Audience of one.

entries.game_text: Fine. But I'm billing you for snacks.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [short pause] Fine. [chuckles] But I'm billing you for snacks.

entries.game_text: I'll manage, Magistrate-sama. I know the difference.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] I'll manage, Magistrate-sama. I know the difference.

entries.game_text: Honored Magistrate-sama — shall I present the tea before or after the terms you mentioned on the thirtieth?
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Honored Magistrate-sama — shall I present the tea before or after the terms you mentioned on the thirtieth?

entries.game_text: You said we'd discuss residency. I'm listening.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] You said we'd discuss residency. I'm listening.

entries.game_text: Guest room. Preview. You really do enjoy making people come back.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Guest room. Preview. You really do enjoy making people come back.

entries.game_text: Live-in companion. That's — that's not a guest room preview, that's a contract.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Live-in companion. That's — that's not a guest room preview, [short pause] that's a contract.

entries.game_text: Day or night. You ask a great deal, Magistrate-sama.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Day or night. You ask a great deal, Magistrate-sama.

entries.game_text: And the stipend?
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] And the stipend?

entries.game_text: Three koku is more than the curry shop paid me to smile at tourists.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Three koku is more than the curry shop paid me to smile at tourists.

entries.game_text: Shock and delight, both at once. You do that to me.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Shock and delight, both at once. You do that to me.

entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, I accept the appointment and its duties. You will have my discretion and my attendance.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Magistrate-sama, [short pause] I accept the appointment and its duties. You will have my discretion and my attendance.

entries.game_text: I'll sign when we define release. And which nights are mine for Academy correspondence.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] I'll sign when we define release. And which nights are mine for Academy correspondence.

entries.game_text: Escort, not leash. I can work with that.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [calm] Escort, not leash. I can work with that.

entries.game_text: Three koku — fine, wonderful, I'll frame the ledger. But Magistrate-sama, I want the room. I want the hall. I want to be here.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Three koku — fine, [short pause] wonderful, I'll frame the ledger. But Magistrate-sama, I want the room. I want the hall. I want to be here.

entries.game_text: That came out louder than professional.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] That came out louder than professional.

entries.game_text: Case One. Files, witnesses, and snacks for the road.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Case One. [chuckles] Files, witnesses, and snacks for the road.

entries.game_text: I'll fetch it. I'll learn it. Just — thank you. For the room adjoining yours.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [excited] I'll fetch it. I'll learn it. Just — thank you. For the room adjoining yours.

entries.game_text: Archive. Escort. Written terms. I'm holding you to all three.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Archive. Escort. Written terms. I'm holding you to all three.

entries.game_text: Understood. I'll return with the docket and dry obijime.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Understood. I'll return with the docket and dry obijime.

entries.game_text: Point me to the chamber. I'd rather unpack before the archive swallows me.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Point me to the chamber. I'd rather unpack before the archive swallows me.

entries.game_text: I only peeked once. You noticed.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] I only peeked once. You noticed.

entries.game_text: Archive first. You'll know I'm serious when I come back dusty.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Archive first. You'll know I'm serious when I come back dusty.

entries.game_text: Case One, archive, and your cup is empty. Companion duty starts now.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Case One, archive, and your cup is empty. Companion duty starts now.

entries.game_text: Cruel — and fair. The cup first, then.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Cruel — and fair. The cup first, then.

entries.game_text: Snacks after paperwork still applies. Even for corpses without funerals.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Snacks after paperwork still applies. [chuckles] Even for corpses without funerals.

entries.game_text: Case One. No bells, dry obijime, and I kept hold of the ledger.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Case One. No bells, dry obijime, and I kept hold of the ledger.

entries.game_text: You said archive dust was acceptable. So is my breathing.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] You said archive dust was acceptable. So is my breathing.

entries.game_text: Docket retrieved. Still breathing.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Docket retrieved. Still breathing.

entries.game_text: Clean water, dirty ledger. Who found them?
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Clean water, dirty ledger. Who found them?

entries.game_text: Miya means Crane politics. Crane politics means you, Magistrate-sama.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Miya means Crane politics. Crane politics means you, Magistrate-sama.

entries.game_text: Escort to the canal. Written terms. I'm collecting.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Escort to the canal. Written terms. I'm collecting.

entries.game_text: I came back. That should count for something.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] I came back. That should count for something.

entries.game_text: Snacks after paperwork. Even for corpses without funerals.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Snacks after paperwork. [chuckles] Even for corpses without funerals.

entries.game_text: Retainer's knot tied left-handed. Haori is two sizes wide — borrowed. No wallet, no letter case.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Retainer's knot tied left-handed. Haori is two sizes wide — borrowed. No wallet, [short pause] no letter case.

entries.game_text: Who profits if Crane thread snaps in Scorpion current?
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Who profits if Crane thread snaps in Scorpion current?

entries.game_text: Witness notes: time of recovery, position, clothing, visible wounds. Theories wait.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Witness notes: time of recovery, [short pause] position, clothing, visible wounds. Theories wait.

entries.game_text: Furniture with legs still learns the route.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Furniture with legs still learns the route.

entries.game_text: And the wrongness? The air feels thin — like someone peeled a charm and left the paper.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] And the wrongness? The air feels thin — like someone peeled a charm and left the paper.

entries.game_text: Point. I'll witness.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Point. I'll witness.

entries.game_text: He looks borrowed too. Even in death.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] He looks borrowed too. Even in death.

entries.game_text: Haori upstream, body here. Current or carriage?
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Haori upstream, body here. Current or carriage?

entries.game_text: Palms soft yesterday, ink stain on index finger — ledger work. Sleeve hem chewed by canal slime upstream, not here.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Palms soft yesterday, [short pause] ink stain on index finger — ledger work. Sleeve hem chewed by canal slime upstream, not here.

entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama — his throat bruises like fingers, not water.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Magistrate-sama — his throat bruises like fingers, not water.

entries.game_text: Witness note: recovery at canal mark three, noble quarter. Clothing as listed. Cause pending magistrate review.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Witness note: recovery at canal mark three, [short pause] noble quarter. Clothing as listed. Cause pending magistrate review.

entries.game_text: Comb. Scorpion mon inlaid. Not Miya.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Comb. Scorpion mon inlaid. Not Miya.

entries.game_text: Guest-house clerk, Crane thread, Scorpion comb. Someone staged a poem and forgot the audience.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Guest-house clerk, [short pause] Crane thread, Scorpion comb. Someone staged a poem and forgot the audience.

entries.game_text: Case One has a face now. I won't forget Jiro.

entries.game_text: And me? Another bolt room, or steel?
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] And me? Another bolt room, or steel?

entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, I am not decoration.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Magistrate-sama, I am not decoration.

entries.game_text: Grey wax, sixteenth-petal forgery again. Case One's flower did not drown — it warehouses.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Grey wax, [short pause] sixteenth-petal forgery again. Case One's flower did not drown — it warehouses.

entries.game_text: Foreman Kurogane. Scorpion pay, Crane front crates. He bolted when the clerk ran.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Foreman Kurogane. Scorpion pay, [short pause] Crane front crates. He bolted when the clerk ran.

entries.game_text: Stairs are mine. You take the floor. I will not break formation.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Stairs are mine. You take the floor. I will not break formation.

entries.game_text: Then talk to my witness note — after you sheathe.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Then talk to my witness note — after you sheathe.

entries.game_text: You — you took the cut meant for me.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [warmly] You — you took the cut meant for me.

entries.game_text: I am not — that is not — I will write the blade line first.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] I am not — that is not [short pause] — I will write the blade line first.

entries.game_text: I stayed because the file said witness. Not because—
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] I stayed because the file said witness. Not because—

entries.game_text: Case Four's line is written. The city still lies — but I am still at your door.
entries.tts_text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Case Four's line is written. The city still lies — but I am still at your door.

entries.game_text: Then punish me, Magistrate-sama. You've threatened it since I touched the wrong door.
entries.tts_text: [defiant] [cheerfully] Then punish me, [short pause] Magistrate-sama. You've threatened it since I touched the wrong door.

entries.game_text: I didn't— I meant you wouldn't—
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [short pause] I didn't— I meant you wouldn't—

entries.game_text: ...Wouldn't dare. Keep guessing.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [defiant] [short pause] ...Wouldn't dare. Keep guessing.

entries.game_text: Behind closed screens. You heard me the first time.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] Behind closed screens. You heard me the first time.

entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama— one more pass at the canal—
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Magistrate-sama— one more pass at the canal—
